paragraphs: They are mentioned in Eruvin 76b and Sukkah 8a.[^1]

notes.text: The heading and verb are plural. Eruvin עו: and Sukkah ח. are conventionally76b and8a, using colon and period respectively; neither locator has been independently checked against a named edition.
